text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Vodka in the lead!! Vodka in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Vodka! Vodka has prevailed in this fierce battle!
She's put her strength on full display!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Vodkaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah..., hah...!
—...Haha! Hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won...!! I did it...!!
I'm the one who won the Japan Cup!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Me!! It's ME!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's the champion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――……
I couldn't reach them……!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Just one more step... If only
I could've pushed out a little more strength—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even though I might have been able
to catch up to that valiant back—...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: DESIREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Well done!" "That was incredible!"—
A deafening roar of cheers and praises rains down upon Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
After running through all the Triple Tiara races...
I thought nothing could ever surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: “However, that was not the case. —It was impossible.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My heart
is still screaming to be fulfilled!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... More—
More, more, more—...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That was a great match, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I'd let my guard down, I would've been swallowed whole!
Desire, you've definitely gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Don't stop here, got it?
Both you and I can go much further."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your running can change the world someday.
You might even reach another world before long!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as I thought, the light you emit...
is truly so strong, straightforward, and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It was only because I ran shoulder-to-shoulder with you, giving it our absolute all... that today, I came to know a new kind of brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I yearn for it so desperately,
longing to see the next stage—...!!”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(You are endlessly far ahead, endlessly strong...
But I promise you, I will catch up—!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, you'll always...
you'll always be who I look up to...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Desire!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire and Vodka.
As the two commended each other's fierce efforts after the grueling battle, the venue erupted in even greater cheers—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, Red Desire fought a fierce battle against seasoned contenders across generations at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The attention on her had now reached unimaginable heights.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Give me an even greater challenge—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, grant me even more trials...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, even though my mana has
reached unprecedented heights...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having run through her Classic year with all her might and seized glorious achievements, Red Desire was already looking for her next trial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the upcoming Senior Class,
I want to prepare a stage worthy of her.
I must plan this meticulously.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, for someone like you, I've got some good news, you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your overwhelming power,
and the strongest legs that won so many incredible races!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"With those, I should be able to go somewhere far from here...
Even across the ocean."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next year, why don't you go on an adventure
into the wide world with me!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The wide world...?
Don't tell me――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To cross the sea and take on the vast, boundless world...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I can conquer the race there,
I might just be able to reach that "Otherworld"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps the true nature of the 'Otherworld'
is taking on races overseas."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasn't as though I hadn't considered that, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having run through the Triple Tiara races and fought valiantly in the Japan Cup, those words now resonate with far greater reality.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The genius Trainer, <username>!
Another brilliant achievement!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Following her Triple Crown triumph, she's finally conquered the Breeders' Cup, toooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could give shape to that childhood longing
I dreamed of that day, together with Red Desire,
how wonderful that would be."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Now is my time to take on the challenge, too—
To the world, alongside Vodka!
choice_data_list: Yeah...! Let's set our sights overseas for the Senior Year!
Yeah...! Let's set our sights overseas in our senior year!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
They're everywhere across the world.
People waiting for a saint...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The tale of the Saint Red Desire
is finally crossing national borders, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand ambition: taking on the world.
It felt as though a smooth, hopeful path leading into an entirely different world had finally opened up.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, my bad! 
I got way too heated and flushed up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then next year, we're taking on overseas races!
It's a promise, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Absolutely!
It's a promise!
